title: Non-invertible Nielsen circuits and 3d Ising gravity
summary: We extend Nielsen's formulation of quantum circuit complexity to include intrinsically non-invertible operations. Such gates arise from fusion with topological defect operators and remove a basic limitation of symmetry-based circuits: the inability to change superselection sectors, or in two-dimensional CFTs, conformal families. We realise fusion operations as completely positive, trace-preserving quantum channels acting between sectors, with consistency ensured by the fusion and associator data of an underlying unitary modular tensor category.
